# Step 3: Format eggNOG Annotations

```{r format-annotations}
# Read eggNOG-mapper output
eggnog <- read_tsv("eggnog_files/out.emapper.annotations",
                   skip = 4, comment = "##")

# Read protein-to-gene mapping
prot_to_gene <- read_tsv("sa2_headers_prot.tsv", col_names = c("protein_id", "gene_id"))

# Clean eggNOG query IDs - remove prefix like "ngl|WGS:ZZZZ|"
eggnog <- eggnog %>%
  mutate(`#query` = str_remove(`#query`, "^.*\\|"))

# Extract GO annotations
go_annotations <- eggnog %>%
  dplyr::select(query = `#query`, GOs) %>%
  filter(!is.na(GOs), GOs != "") %>%
  separate_rows(GOs, sep = ",") %>%
  dplyr::rename(GO = GOs) %>%
  # Convert protein IDs to gene IDs
  left_join(prot_to_gene, by = c("query" = "protein_id")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene_id)) %>%
  dplyr::select(query = gene_id, GO)

# Create TERM2GENE and TERM2NAME for GO
term2gene_go <- go_annotations %>%
  dplyr::select(GO, query)

go_terms <- AnnotationDbi::select(GO.db, 
                                  keys = unique(term2gene_go$GO),
                                  columns = c("GOID", "TERM"),
                                  keytype = "GOID")
term2name_go <- go_terms %>%
  dplyr::rename(GO = GOID, Description = TERM)

# Extract KEGG annotations
kegg_annotations <- eggnog %>%
  dplyr::select(query = `#query`, KEGG_ko, KEGG_Pathway) %>%
  filter(!is.na(KEGG_ko), KEGG_ko != "") %>%
  separate_rows(KEGG_ko, sep = ",") %>%
  mutate(KEGG_ko = str_remove(KEGG_ko, "ko:")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(KEGG = KEGG_ko) %>%
  # Convert protein IDs to gene IDs
  left_join(prot_to_gene, by = c("query" = "protein_id")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene_id)) %>%
  dplyr::select(query = gene_id, KEGG, KEGG_Pathway)

# Create TERM2GENE and TERM2NAME for KEGG
term2gene_kegg <- kegg_annotations %>%
  dplyr::select(KEGG, query)

kegg_pathways <- eggnog %>%
  dplyr::select(KEGG_Pathway) %>%
  filter(!is.na(KEGG_Pathway), KEGG_Pathway != "") %>%
  separate_rows(KEGG_Pathway, sep = ",") %>%
  distinct() %>%
  separate(KEGG_Pathway, into = c("KEGG", "Description"), 
           sep = ":", extra = "merge", fill = "right") %>%
  mutate(KEGG = str_remove(KEGG, "ko"),
         Description = str_trim(Description))

term2name_kegg <- kegg_pathways

# Save annotations
save(term2gene_go, term2name_go, 
     term2gene_kegg, term2name_kegg,
     file = "locust_annotations.RData")
```

# Step 4: Cell-Level Pathway Scoring

```{r RESUME-POINT 12.3.2025}
# Resume here
load("locust_annotations.RData")

```

```{r cell-level-scoring}
# Load Seurat object
seurat_obj <- readRDS("/home/davidbellini/OneDrive/gabbiani/PROJECTS/americana_atlas3/R_analysis/sa3_labels_mar31.rds")
seurat_obj <- UpdateSeuratObject(seurat_obj)

# Set RNA as default assay for pathway analysis (not SCT)
cat("Available assays:", names(seurat_obj@assays), "\n")
cat("Current default assay:", DefaultAssay(seurat_obj), "\n")
DefaultAssay(seurat_obj) <- "RNA"
cat("Changed to RNA assay\n\n")

# Ensure RNA assay is normalized
if(!"data" %in% Layers(seurat_obj[["RNA"]])) {
  cat("Normalizing RNA assay...\n")
  seurat_obj <- NormalizeData(seurat_obj, assay = "RNA")
}

# Add active.ident as a metadata column for easier labeling
seurat_obj$cell_type <- Idents(seurat_obj)

# Check overlap between eggNOG genes and Seurat genes
seurat_genes <- rownames(seurat_obj)
eggnog_genes <- unique(term2gene_go$query)

overlap <- intersect(seurat_genes, eggnog_genes)
cat("Seurat genes:", length(seurat_genes), "\n")
cat("eggNOG genes:", length(eggnog_genes), "\n")
cat("Overlap:", length(overlap), "\n")
cat("Overlap %:", round(100 * length(overlap) / length(seurat_genes), 2), "%\n\n")

# Filter term2gene to only include genes present in Seurat object
term2gene_go_filtered <- term2gene_go %>%
  filter(query %in% seurat_genes)

# Create gene set list from GO annotations
gene_sets_go <- term2gene_go_filtered %>%
  group_by(GO) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(query)) %>%
  deframe()

gene_sets_kegg <- term2gene_kegg %>%
  filter(query %in% seurat_genes) %>%
  group_by(KEGG) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(query)) %>%
  deframe()

# Filter gene sets to 15-500 genes
gene_set_sizes <- sapply(gene_sets_go, length)
gene_sets_go_filtered <- gene_sets_go[gene_set_sizes >= 15 & gene_set_sizes <= 500]

cat("Gene sets after filtering:", length(gene_sets_go_filtered), "\n")

# Run UCell scoring via escape
seurat_obj <- runEscape(seurat_obj,
                        gene.sets = gene_sets_go_filtered,
                        method = "UCell",
                        new.assay.name = "escape_GO")

# Find most variable pathways across cells (not just first alphabetically!)
pathway_scores <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, assay = "escape_GO", layer = "data")

# Calculate variance for each pathway
pathway_variance <- apply(pathway_scores, 1, var)
top_variable_pathways <- names(sort(pathway_variance, decreasing = TRUE))[1:20]

# Get descriptions for top variable pathways
top_pathway_info <- term2name_go %>%
  filter(GO %in% gsub("escapego_", "", top_variable_pathways)) %>%
  mutate(GO_clean = gsub("GO:", "", GO),
         label = paste0(GO, ": ", Description))

cat("\nTop 20 most variable pathways across cells:\n")
print(as.data.frame(top_pathway_info %>% dplyr::select(GO, Description)), row.names = FALSE)

# Visualize top 4 most variable pathways on UMAP
top_4_pathways <- top_variable_pathways[1:4]

cat("\n\nVisualizing these 4 pathways on UMAP:\n")
for(pathway in top_4_pathways) {
  go_id <- gsub("escapego_", "", pathway)
  desc <- term2name_go %>% filter(GO == go_id) %>% pull(Description)
  cat(go_id, ":", desc, "\n")
}

FeaturePlot(seurat_obj,
            features = top_4_pathways,
            reduction = "umap")

# Rename pathways in the Seurat object to have readable descriptions
# Create a mapping of GO IDs to short descriptions
pathway_rename_map <- setNames(
  sapply(top_variable_pathways, function(x) {
    go_id <- gsub("escapego_", "", x)
    go_id <- gsub("_", ":", go_id)
    desc <- term2name_go %>% filter(GO == go_id) %>% pull(Description)
    if(length(desc) > 0) {
      # Truncate long descriptions
      str_trunc(desc, 50)
    } else {
      x
    }
  }),
  top_variable_pathways
)

# Create a modified version of the escape assay with renamed features
escape_renamed <- seurat_obj[["escape_GO"]]
rownames(escape_renamed) <- ifelse(rownames(escape_renamed) %in% names(pathway_rename_map),
                                    pathway_rename_map[rownames(escape_renamed)],
                                    rownames(escape_renamed))
seurat_obj[["escape_GO_labeled"]] <- escape_renamed

# Show available cell types
cat("\nAvailable cell types:\n")
print(sort(unique(seurat_obj$cell_type)))

# EDIT THIS LIST: Specify which cell types you want to visualize
cell_types_to_show <- c("TmY5a", "Tm9", "Mi1", "L3", "PR", "T4", "T5")
# Subset to selected cell types
seurat_subset <- subset(seurat_obj, subset = cell_type %in% cell_types_to_show)

# Heatmap by cluster (using most variable pathways with readable names)
# The dendrogram on the left clusters pathways by similarity
dittoHeatmap(seurat_subset,
             genes = pathway_rename_map[top_variable_pathways],
             assay = "escape_GO_labeled",
             annot.by = "cell_type",
             scaled.to.max = TRUE,
             fontsize_row = 7,
             main = "Pathway Activity Across Selected Cell Types")

# Violin plot by cluster (more reliable than ridge plot)
VlnPlot(seurat_obj,
        features = top_variable_pathways[1:6],
        assay = "escape_GO",
        ncol = 3,
        pt.size = 0)
```

# Step 5: Marker-Based Enrichment (for single-condition atlas)

```{r marker-enrichment}
# Find marker genes for each cluster
# This identifies genes that define each cell type
cat("Finding marker genes for all clusters...\n")
Idents(seurat_obj) <- seurat_obj$cell_type
markers <- FindAllMarkers(seurat_obj,
                          only.pos = TRUE,
                          min.pct = 0.1,
                          logfc.threshold = 0.5,
                          assay = "RNA")

cat("Found", nrow(markers), "marker genes across all clusters\n\n")

# Show top markers per cluster
top_markers <- markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5)

cat("Top 5 markers per cluster:\n")
print(top_markers %>% dplyr::select(cluster, gene, avg_log2FC, p_val_adj))

# Run GO enrichment for each cluster's markers
cluster_enrichments <- list()

for(clust in unique(markers$cluster)) {
  cat("\nEnriching cluster:", clust, "\n")

  # Get significant markers for this cluster
  cluster_genes <- markers %>%
    filter(cluster == clust, p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
    pull(gene)

  cat("  Markers:", length(cluster_genes), "\n")

  if(length(cluster_genes) >= 10) {  # Need at least 10 genes
    # GO enrichment
    enrich_go <- enricher(gene = cluster_genes,
                          TERM2GENE = term2gene_go,
                          TERM2NAME = term2name_go,
                          pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                          pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                          minGSSize = 10,
                          maxGSSize = 500)

    if(!is.null(enrich_go) && nrow(enrich_go@result) > 0) {
      cluster_enrichments[[clust]] <- enrich_go
      cat("  Enriched pathways:", nrow(enrich_go@result), "\n")
    } else {
      cat("  No significant enrichment\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("  Too few markers for enrichment\n")
  }
}

# Save enrichment results
saveRDS(cluster_enrichments, file = "cluster_enrichments.rds")
saveRDS(markers, file = "cluster_markers.rds")
```

## Visualize Enrichment Results

```{r visualize-enrichment}
# Plot enrichment for a specific cluster of interest
cluster_enrichments = readRDS("cluster_enrichments.rds")
markers = readRDS("cluster_markers.rds")
cluster_to_plot <- "PAM"  # Change to your cluster of interest

if(cluster_to_plot %in% names(cluster_enrichments)) {
  cat("\nShowing enrichment for:", cluster_to_plot, "\n\n")

  # Dotplot
  print(dotplot(cluster_enrichments[[cluster_to_plot]],
                showCategory = 20,
                title = paste0("GO Enrichment: ", cluster_to_plot)))

  # Barplot
  print(barplot(cluster_enrichments[[cluster_to_plot]],
                showCategory = 15,
                title = paste0("GO Enrichment: ", cluster_to_plot)))
}

# Compare enrichment across SELECTED clusters
if(length(cluster_enrichments) > 0) {
  # EDIT THIS: Choose specific clusters to compare (use same as heatmap)
  clusters_to_compare <- c("TmY5a", "Tm9", "Mi1", "L3", "PR")

  # Filter to clusters that have enrichment results
  clusters_to_compare <- clusters_to_compare[clusters_to_compare %in% names(cluster_enrichments)]

  if(length(clusters_to_compare) > 1) {
    # Prepare marker genes for selected clusters only
    cluster_marker_lists <- list()
    for(clust in clusters_to_compare) {
      cluster_marker_lists[[clust]] <- markers %>%
        filter(cluster == clust, p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
        pull(gene)
    }

    # Compare enrichment across selected clusters
    cat("\nComparing enrichment across selected clusters...\n")
    comparison <- compareCluster(geneCluster = cluster_marker_lists,
                                 fun = "enricher",
                                 TERM2GENE = term2gene_go,
                                 TERM2NAME = term2name_go,
                                 pvalueCutoff = 0.01,  # More stringent
                                 minGSSize = 10,
                                 maxGSSize = 500)

    # Dotplot comparison - FEWER pathways, readable labels
    print(dotplot(comparison,
                  showCategory = 5,  # Only top 5 per cluster
                  title = "GO Enrichment Comparison",
                  font.size = 8,
                  label_format = 50))  # Truncate long labels
  }
}
```
